description: Source code for the ExceptionHandler class in the Google Breakpad crash reporting library, handling signal registration, dump generation, and crash context management on Linux systems.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: Handles crash signal registration, dump creation, and crash context management for Linux in the Breakpad library.

methods.name: WriteMinidump
methods.description: Generates a minidump of the current process, optionally invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: WriteMinidumpForChild
methods.description: Creates a minidump for a specified child process, used in crash handling.

methods.name: RegisterAppMemory
methods.description: Registers a memory region to be included in minidumps.

methods.name: UnregisterAppMemory
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered memory region.
